alt.de: Die Santa María auf der Atlantikfahrt von 1492 als frei drehbares 3D-Modell: Holzrumpf, Deck, drei Masten, Segel und Takelage. Betrachte das Schiff von der Seite und von oben. alt.en: An interactive 3D reconstruction of the Santa María on the Atlantic voyage of 1492, showing its wooden hull, deck, three masts, sails and rigging. Explore the ship from the side and from above. The hull shape, dimensions and details are modelling choices, not surviving original plans.

source:loc-columbus-taino.bibliographicNote: Read the introductory account and “Columbus’s Account of 1492 Voyage”. Used for Indigenous societies and the colonial claims in the letter. Its simplified identification of Guanahani is not treated as resolving the disputed landfall.

source:powerhouse-santa-maria-h4306.title: Ship model of 'Santa Maria' captained by Christopher Columbus in 1492
